blocks.html:
Start here

AION 2 is NCSoft's Unreal Engine 5 sequel to AION. Global PC launch is confirmed for October 5, 2026, with a rocky Korea/Taiwan launch behind it that reshaped the West's monetization plan. Here is what a beginner needs to know before the first login.

blocks.title: What AION 2 is and how global differs from KR/TW
blocks.titleEn: What AION 2 is and how global differs from KR/TW
blocks.bodyHtml:
AION 2 is NCSoft's UE5 sequel to AION, already live in Korea/Taiwan since a rocky launch in Nov 2025.

What it is

AION 2 is NCSoft's Unreal Engine 5 sequel and remake of the original AION. It keeps the Elyos vs Asmodian conflict and the same eight classes.

Marketing describes a playable world roughly 36 times larger than the original, with flight restrictions removed. unverified

Spot-check 2026-09-12: the cited lagofast page does not contain this comparison; treat the size figure as marketing folklore until an official source states it.

Korea and Taiwan launched first

Korea and Taiwan launched on November 19, 2025 nc.com, 2025-111 mmorpg.com, kr-era2.

kr-era That launch was rocky, and NCSoft had to scramble:

  • 40 servers went live with congestion and a character-name registration bug, forcing emergency maintenance.
  • Within about 15 hours, NCSoft apologized for cash-shop bundles that included gear-enhancement items it had previously promised would not be sold for real money.
  • NC pulled the bundles, gave the enhancement items free to everyone, zeroed skill-reset costs, and halved cash-shop consumable prices.
  • NCSoft's stock reportedly dropped about 15% in a single day massivelyop.com, 2025-113 aion2.online, date unknown4 vpesports.com, date unknown5.

Despite the backlash, AION 2 reportedly earned about $70 million in its first six weeks in Korea and Taiwan. single source escapistmagazine.com, date unknown6

Unclear: the exact global level cap. KR/TW raised its cap from 45 to 50 around July 2026, but global may launch with active-skill and Stigma caps at "Level 20" while the character cap could still be 45. NC has not clarified which numbers apply globally. single source, lower-trust mmoexp.com, date unknown7

Background: mmoculture.com, 2026-078, ldcloud.net, date unknown9

blocks.title: Launch schedule and platforms
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Global PC launch Oct 5, 2026 confirmed
blocks.bodyHtml:
Global PC launch is locked for Oct 5, 2026 on Steam and PURPLE, with a free scale test Sep 17-18.

Launch date

Global PC launch is confirmed for October 5, 2026 on Steam and NC's PURPLE launcher, announced at gamescom Opening Night Live on August 25, 2026.

This replaced an earlier, vaguer "September 2026" window that NC has not explained. aion2hub.com, date unknown1 aion2hub.com, 2026-092 timesaver.gg, date unknown3

  1. Sep 16
    Pre-download opens

    Ahead of the free Launch Scale Test.

  2. Sep 17-18
    Free public Launch Scale Test

    Open to anyone via Steam page sign-up aion2hub.com, date unknown4 iggm.com, date unknown5.

  3. Sep 28
    Founder's Pack pre-load

    Reportedly opens around this date.

  4. Sep 30 to Oct 4
    Founder's Pack Advance Access

    5-day paid head start, all three tiers included all.gg, date unknown6 expcarry.com, date unknown7.

  5. Oct 5
    Global public launch

    PC only, via Steam or PURPLE.

Platforms and requirements

Platforms: PC only at global launch. No console version exists anywhere yet, including KR/TW; a console port is reportedly in progress but far from finished, with no PlayStation/Xbox timeline.

Mobile clients exist for KR/TW only, with no Western mobile release announced. exitlag.com, date unknown8 lagofast.com, date unknown9

PC system requirements single source: Minimum, Windows 10/11 64-bit, Ryzen 5 2600 or Core i5-10500, 8GB RAM, GTX 1050 Ti (4GB), DirectX 12, 100GB storage. Recommended, Ryzen 7 3700X or Core i7-11700, 16GB RAM, RTX 2070 (8GB). noping.com, date unknown10

Also see: aion2hub.com, date unknown11 on pre-registration.

blocks.title: Faction and server choice
blocks.bodyHtml:
Faction and server choice is permanent, faction-locked, and mostly cosmetic, so pick where your friends are.

What it is

Faction and server choice is a single, largely permanent decision. Elyos and Asmodians sit on faction-exclusive servers, and you generally only meet the other faction in instanced content, Abyss battles, or specific events.

There is currently no stated way to switch factions later. guildorder.com, date unknown1 mein-mmo.de, 2026-092 lootwow.com, date unknown3

Both factions share the same 8 classes and the same faction-war endgame; there is no evidence of a power difference between them, so the choice is cosmetic and social rather than a power tier. Elyos start in Poeta (western, light-aligned, capital Sanctum); Asmodians occupy the eastern/dark-aligned side.

Beginner tip: because Legions (guilds) are faction-locked, picking the same faction and server as friends matters far more here than in games where players can freely mix.

Classes

Classes (8 total), trinity-organized: Tank, Templar; Melee DPS, Gladiator and Assassin; Ranged physical DPS, Ranger; Magic DPS, Sorcerer and Spiritmaster; Healer, Cleric; Hybrid support, Chanter. single source, lower-trust mmoexp.com, date unknown4

Also see: aion2wiki.com, date unknown5, exitlag.com, date unknown6, timesaver.gg, date unknown7

blocks.title: Free to play, with an asterisk
blocks.titleEn: Free to play, with an asterisk
blocks.bodyHtml:
Global needs no subscription to play, but a $15/month Membership gates the player-driven economy.

Global is free to play with no subscription required to play, but an optional $15/month Membership unlocks:

  • The player Market
  • The Kinah/Quna currency exchange
  • Face-to-face trading

Without Membership, players are reportedly locked out of most of the player-driven economy. There is also a per-character premium Daeva Pass, a cosmetics/consumables cash shop, and the Founder's Packs. Two currencies exist: Kinah (earned in-game) and Quna (premium, also exchangeable for Kinah). mmorpg.com, 2026-071 massivelyop.com, 2026-072

Why it matters: this "sell access to the economy, not power directly" model has drawn criticism as free to play "with an asterisk the size of a subscription fee." See the Money panel for the full monetization breakdown.

Also see: aion2hub.com, date unknown3

blocks.title: Alt characters and the 84-run rule
blocks.headExtrasHtml: confirmed existence 90% figure single source
blocks.bodyHtml:
Past 84 dungeon clears a week, your whole account's tradeable Kinah and gear drops get cut hard.

What it is

Once an account registers 84 combined dungeon clears within a single weekly lockout period, tradeable Kinah and gear drops are reduced (one source says by 90%) for the rest of that week, across all characters on the account, not just the one that hit the threshold.

The restriction is account-wide by design, to stop players from running many alts to funnel loot onto one main character. youtube.com, kr-era1 mmoexp.com, date unknown2

Kinah splits into Bound Kinah (non-tradeable, usable for NPC costs) and Tradeable Kinah (broker-eligible); only tradeable drops are affected by the 84-run penalty, so bound-currency income for alts is unaffected. single source mmoexp.com, date unknown3

Where the breakpoints are

Community guides suggest running up to roughly 84 dungeon clears per account per week for full Kinah efficiency; beyond that, efficiency drops sharply, with a second breakpoint around 126 runs cited for players chasing materials rather than Kinah. single source, unverified mmoexp.com, date unknown4

Beginner tip: focus one main character until it reaches the power threshold where clears become fast, before investing in alts. Per-character systems (Daeva Pass, Stigma, gear) do not share progress. boostroom.com, 2026-025 mein-mmo.de, 2026-096
Tension worth noting: the Daeva Pass is sold per character, which incentivizes alts, while the 84-run system discourages heavy alt-running for Kinah. Rolling one or two alts for Daeva Pass or side content appears fine; running dozens purely to farm dungeon loot is what the 84-run system targets.

Also see: vortexgaming.io, date unknown7 on alt leveling efficiency.
blocks.tags: alt characters 84 run penalty kinah dungeon

blocks.title: Settings and quality of life
blocks.bodyHtml:
Use the sanctioned two-skill auto-attack macro, rebind a few keys, and expect to tune graphics manually.

Macros

NCSoft added an official auto-attack macro in a KR patch, kr-era limited to automating two specific skills, not a full auto-combat system.

Players reportedly combine it with auto-target settings at stationary farm spots, but guides warn that misusing or over-automating macros risks an account flag, so stick to the sanctioned two-skill macro. u4n.com, date unknown1 boostroom.com, 2026-022

Key rebinds and controller

Suggested key rebinds: move the Defiance/Breakbar key off Spacebar, bind Sprint to Shift, put your primary macro on the right mouse button, and enable combat info overlays plus the Boss Orientation Indicator in the Info Display settings. single source, lower-trust mmoexp.com, date unknown3

Controller support: not confirmed. The game appears designed around mouse and keyboard; no native controller support has been documented for KR/TW or announced for global. fextralife.com, date unknown4

Beginner tip: set up build/gear presets early rather than manually reconfiguring your build every time you swap between PvE and PvP, since manual swapping wastes time and causes configuration errors. boostroom.com, 2026-025

No sources documented specific graphics presets or FPS benchmarks; expect to tune settings manually against the system requirements above once the client is available. The Launch Scale Test (Sept 17-18) is the first real chance to test performance.
blocks.tags: settings macros keybinds controller quality of life

blocks.title: Your first 3 hours
blocks.bodyHtml:
Lock in faction and server, then follow Main Story quests as your primary leveling path.

  1. Do first: lock in your faction and server before you start, it is a permanent decision that determines who you can play with guildorder.com, date unknown1.
  2. Do first: follow the Main Story (Episode) Quests as your primary path. They carry the most XP and gate which systems, zones, and mounts become available exitlag.com, date unknown2 aion2wiki.com, date unknown3.
  3. Then: pick up nearby Region quests once you meet their level requirement. They give lower XP but extra gear and Daevanion Crystals.
  4. Later / optional: do not worry about Stigma slots or Daevanion boards yet, they unlock naturally as you level. See the Leveling and Priorities panel for exact unlock levels.
